{{Top}}
The '''Order of Battle''' was the formal organization of troops within a military force, the combination of formations on different levels which came together to form the fighting machine.

==History==
The term was particularly associated with ground troops, and most specifically, it referred to the order of battle of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and the subsequent [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]], initially known as the '''OrBat''' in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and then as the '''OB''' in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

The [[Navy Order of Battle|Order of Battle]] of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] recognized five fleet formations, including [[Line of battle|line]], [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]], [[systems force]], [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]], and [[Sector Group/Legends|sector group]]. The composition of the Navy Order of Battle was under the purview of the [[Flight Branch]]. A similar Order of Battle was utilized among the [[Stormtrooper Corps/Legends|Stormtrooper Corps]].
